corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: The report proposes twenty ethical recommendations for connected and automated vehicles, with sustained treatment of AI, data protection, fairness and explainability in road mobility.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: PDF p.2 says manuscript completed in June 2020 and first edition; it does not state an exact internal day. The official OP release of 17 September 2020 is used as publication fallback. The PDF credits the expert group as bibliographic author. PDF p.4 lists members Jean-François Bonnefon (Chairman), David Černý, John Danaher, Nathalie Devillier, Veronica Johansson, Tatiana Kovacikova, Marieke Martens, Milos N. Mladenovic, Paula Palade, Nick Reed, Filippo Santoni de Sio (Rapporteur), Stavroula Tsinorema, Sandra Wachter and Karolina Zawieska. Their membership is preserved without converting each member into an individually credited author. DG RTD's OP corporate-metadata entry does not supersede the report's explicit authorship citation.
